evidence: Compared every launch assumption in task/tests/test.sh (byte-identical to the frozen template test.sh; tests/Dockerfile and environment/Dockerfile also identical to template) with the brief and notes. AGREE: (1) entry: test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js and test.sh:111 runs `node $APP_ENTRY`; instruction.md:15 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5. (2) port/probe: test.sh:48 probes http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then /, HTTPError counts as ready; instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set), expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:5-6 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; integration.md:9-10 health answers before database work. Judge prompts and app_context.md:4 use only http://localhost:3000 (no public address; Colderwater lesson 13 checked: grep of tests/, instruction and notes finds no non-local URL). (3) env vars: test.sh:104-109 env -i with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH; brief names PORT and DB_PATH (instruction.md:15) and NODE_PATH (integration.md:3-4); PATH/HOME are generic. (4) DB path: test.sh:98-101 sets DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db; instruction.md:15 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'. (5) seed/assets: instruction.md:17 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime ... start with no shipped database'; test.sh never deletes app.db, consistent with the explicit no-shipped-database duty. Verifier keeps /assets via task.toml artifacts, so the brief is stricter than the verifier (lenient, harms no conforming app). Golden copies seed to solution/app/src/seed_data.json (identical bytes to environment/assets/seed_data.json). (6) deps: both images install express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally on node:22 with NODE_PATH; instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'. (7) symlinks: test.sh:72-83 rejects links outside /app/node_modules; task-added integration.md:16-19 states it. (8) restart: generated helper relaunches with same env/DB; instruction.md:17 'keep new work across restarts'. (9) accounts/sign-in: instruction.md:19 lists all ten accounts and password; matches app_context.md (and sign-in is house-convention FP anyway). Golden conforms: bootstrap.js:43 listens on PORT||3000 at 0.0.0.0, health answered before DB in bootstrap.js:20; db.js:9 honours DB_PATH; db.js:10 and paths use __dirname. Scripted harness (workspace.cjs:16, hash verified) launched node /app/server.js with cwd /tmp and the sanitized env; server.log shows listening on 3000 twice (restart). GAP (defect): test.sh launches `node /app/server.js` without cd, so the process inherits the verifier's working directory (tests image WORKDIR is /tests, which test.sh:12 makes go-rwx, unreadable to uid 65534), and runs as uid 65534 rather than root. The agent's image has WORKDIR /app (environment/Dockerfile:25), so the builder's own runs of `node /app/server.js` or `node server.js` always have cwd=/app. Neither instruction.md nor integration.md says the app is started from another working directory and must locate its files relative to itself. This is a launch assumption about paths that the brief did not tell the agent, and the agent cannot discover it by testing as instructed. Exact verifier cwd not measured in this round (no full test.sh run in raw-evidence-index), but test.sh contains no cd and the template sets WORKDIR /tests.
counterexample: A conforming app that does everything the brief says (node /app/server.js, PORT 3000, /api/health, DB_PATH honoured, seed copied into /app) but serves its UI with express.static('public') or reads fs.readFileSync('data/seed_data.json') relative to the current directory works in every self-test the brief asks for (cwd=/app in the agent image), yet under test.sh resolves those paths against the inherited cwd (/tests, unreadable to uid 65534): the UI 404s or seeding throws, the render gate fails and the reward is 0 for a reason the brief never stated. Other launch facts checked and agreeing; a broken app that reads /assets at runtime would still launch in the verifier (artifacts keep /assets) but that is lenient, not unfair, and other criteria grade behaviour.
suggested_fix: Add one task-side sentence to environment/instructions/integration.md (no template/harness change): 'We start it as node /app/server.js from a different working directory under an unprivileged account, so locate your files relative to the app itself, not the current directory, and write only under /app (or DB_PATH).'
